title: Have the required pollution certificates before taking a vessel to sea
what: The owner of a vessel must not take it to sea unless it has the pollution certificates the regulations require.

sources.title: Navigation Act 2012
sources.quote: 135 Taking vessels to sea without pollution certificates—owner (1) The owner of a vessel must not take the vessel to sea, or cause or permit another person to take the vessel to sea, if: (a) the vessel is required by the regulations to have a pollution certificate of a specified kind;

reach.condition: if it owns a vessel that the regulations require to have a pollution certificate
